V53_candidate_clause_ledger.statement: Exact finite operator censuses and bounded selector screens exist, but no most-general selector-allowed census for one completed action exists; the Z9 candidate first leaks a dangerous class at degree eight.
The selector-free source plus elementary filter and driver is an explicit local renormalizable four-dimensional action.
Its 218-coordinate holomorphic Hessian is exact, but no single Hessian also contains the Z9 selector, anomaly spectators, three families, four N fields, and a compatible full-rank driver.
The canonical local supersymmetric vacuum and gauge kernel are exact; global, radiative, soft-term, and tunnelling stability are not established.
There is no same-action one-loop matching calculation, physical threshold cancellation, or frozen EFT coefficient array.
The repaired Z9 selector forbids the elementary X(P^2-v^2) driver, and the safe renormalizable neutral-driver search through six added singlet VEVs is rank deficient.
No same-action Wilson array, running to observables, likelihood, or withheld prediction has been constructed.
